processes.

GitHub repo link: KandurataHardware

• Created RESTful APIs to support CRUD operations, user filtering by plan ID and user ID.

• Integrated both manual login and Google OAuth2 authentication using JWT tokens for secure access.
GitHub repo link: Skill Hub

notifications, and a home screen widget for quick task access.

E-commerce platform for discovering and purchasing furniture, with integrated AI capabilities to generate furniture ideas
based on user requirements.

• Built both admin and customer interfaces with JWT authentication for secure access control.
• Admin features include adding/editing/deleting products, managing orders (approve/deny), and tracking
inventory.
• Integrated an AI-based recommendation tool that dynamically generates furniture suggestions based on users’
preferences and room requirements.
